title: Armenian Manuscript (Armenien 128)
shelf_note: A handwritten Armenian hagiographic text in two columns. It matches the record's language and title. No tradition or collection is given to test it against.
structure_note: The counts disagree: structure.pages_translated is 0, but pages_translated_field is 554. One of them is wrong (E2). The OCR's <page-num>271 matches the handwritten '271' on the leaf. Page 533 carrying number 271 fits numbering on one side of each leaf only, with some unnumbered leaves. On that pattern, the 14 backsteps and 17 repeats in 282 numbered pages probably come from misread or uncertain handwritten numerals, not a broken sequence. One page cannot confirm that.

pages.layout: two ruled columns of small cursive Armenian; the first line of the right column is struck through; a short marginal word in the left margin beside left-column line 13; several erased or faded lines below the right column; '271' written at the foot

ocr_errors.problem: Many forms here and across the page are not Classical Armenian words, e.g. 'արծմայ', 'ելսորդանիս', 'կոկապանան', 'աստօսեղեալ', 'հարստմաց'. That points to widespread misreading. The translator's own <meta> says so as well. I cannot give the right readings from the image.

ocr_errors.problem: The script label in the tag may be wrong (O16). Low confidence.

tr_errors.source:
զծով արծմայ Բաղայեալ
էրէին ելսորդանիս իւր
tr_errors.english:
out of the sea, the bound one, Baghay,
was raised up with his attendants;
tr_errors.problem: Fluent narrative built on OCR nonwords, with no uncertainty marker at this point. 'The bound one', 'raised up' and 'attendants' cannot be traced to the source tokens. The resurrection-like event is presented as fact.

tr_errors.source:
եկր Բաղա
կանին հայոց ճէմմայ վերայ
tr_errors.problem: No token in the transcription reads 'church'. The English supplies a sense the OCR does not carry. A note says the reading is uncertain, which hedges it only in part.
'սին' means vain or empty, not 'faithful'. The adjective is invented or reversed.

tr_errors.source:

tr_errors.english:
with garments, and the flourishing
trial lasted until the West;
tr_errors.problem: Garbled source is rendered as English that has no meaning, instead of being marked as untranslatable.

tr_errors.source:
հարստ
մաց նր զանինն զոր խօսե:
tr_errors.english:
and told
him the vision of which he spoke.
tr_errors.problem: 'Vision' is supplied. 'զանինն' does not mean vision. The translator is guessing from context.

book_verdict: This is the right leaf, and the layout and page number agree. But the OCR of this small cursive hand is full of nonwords, and it passes over a struck-through line and erased text. The translation, though it hedges at the top and in its notes, turns garbled lines into confident narrative. A specialist would flag it on sight.
